issue.title: Unnecessary scrollbar in the navbar
issue.body: This seems to be a new regression:

body:
I think it is worthwhile capturing this comment from the closed duplicate here: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/23835#issuecomment-388286335

![out](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15655/39912390-7962b37c-54f6-11e8-9fe7-f6bfb4bd9491.gif)

FWIW, I don't see anything weird except for the fact that Chrome thinks the sidenav's content height is larger than it actually is. The rest of the behavior is normal/expected :grin:
(I still suspect it could be a Chrome bug - possibly related to FlexBox - but I could be wrong.)

Still a problem (on Chrome, Firefox and Safari) so perhaps it is not a browser bug?
In any case, can we live with this and close this issue @IgorMinar ?
